title: Price of install #4 onward
decision: What to charge for the done-for-you plugin install from install #4 onward.

hormozi.reason: Pricing and offer design are the decision

graham.reason: Demand at any price is barely tested

naval.reason: Option C trades hours for a leveraged product

martell.reason: Each install's cost to 10 hours a week

buffett.reason: Downside to consulting income and the $5k reserve

brief: A solo AI consultant sells a $2,000 done-for-you install of the content-ideas plugin and plans 3 installs by 2026-11-30. From install #4 on: raise to $3,500, keep $2,000, or keep $2,000 and add a $500 self-serve setup. The founder leans toward raising.
assumptions: 10 founder hours a week and $5k set aside (assumed)
